cuda.label: NVIDIA CUDA
cuda.summary: GeForce, RTX and data-centre GPUs. Fastest option for NVIDIA cards.

rocm.label: AMD ROCm
rocm.summary: Radeon RX 7000 / 9000 and Ryzen AI. Uses AMD's official PyTorch wheels for Windows.
rocm.note: AMD publishes per-architecture wheel indexes. If installation fails, paste the index URL for your GPU from rocm.docs.amd.com into Advanced.

xpu.label: Intel XPU
xpu.summary: Intel Arc and Core Ultra graphics, via PyTorch's XPU backend.

directml.label: DirectML
directml.summary: Any DirectX 12 GPU. Broadest compatibility, full precision only, slower.

cpu.label: CPU only
cpu.summary: Works on every PC. Several times slower than a GPU.
